name: encode-mouse-fetal-chromatin-mm10-figwig
title: Mouse fetal chromatin: 256 tracks on chr1
description: Mouse fetal chromatin: 256 tracks on chr1

Eight histone marks in forebrain, heart, limb and liver at E11.5, E12.5, E13.5 and E15.5, with two biological replicates per condition. Native-resolution ENCODE fold-change signals are retained across mm10 chr1.

Use the bookmarks to change genomic scale and the visible track set. Compare signal magnitudes within a histone mark; the displayed rows share a dynamic linear y-scale. Missing observations are distinct from measured zeros.
Fast Figwig mode uses rounded sum summaries with missing observations contributing zero at coarse scales. Zooming below tile resolution reads raw values and averages observed bases.

Reference tracks show UCSC mm10 cytobands, the ENCODE4 cCRE registry combined across biosamples, and GENCODE M25 genes. The reference annotations cover the canonical genome; histone signals cover chr1 only.
